_comment: Container images by tool, one .sif per tool. The file name carries the
version pin of record; there is no second list to keep in sync.
Each image is written against one of two roots, which are the only part
{shared}  a read-only library maintained by someone else
{ours}    images we pull or build ourselves
Roots are resolved by src/containers.py for the platform passed to
holding the clone, which is how a platform with no institutional reference
tree keeps its images beside the checkout.
A rule with a container: directive runs under --use-singularity and must
NOT also call module load, which does not exist inside the image.

BIGSKY._note: BigSky has a /data/openomics/SIFs but it carries only 1 of the 23 images pinned here, so both roots point at our own directory beside the clone and every image is pulled there by `viralrecon cache`.

images._picard_note: the shared ccbr_picard_v0.0.1.sif carries java and a bare picard.jar but no `picard` launcher, and is 2.11.0 against the 2.27.3 we pin
images._plotting_note: report figures use matplotlib, which the pinned quast image already carries (3.10.0) - no separate image is pulled for them. If quast is ever bumped, check that matplotlib survives the bump.
